title: Continuity makes certified neighboring comparisons bijective
statement: Let P be a predicate on schemes [def-pc-scheme] and suppose that every S with P(S) satisfies the stage-continuity property [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-stage-continuity]. For abelian groups A,B and a homomorphism v:A→B with a stage-cohomology comparison certificate [def-weil-pbc-stage-cohomology-comparison] for P, v is bijective.

source.place: Tag 09YQ (theorem-colimit), stage-continuity invocation; elementary colimit universal property and finite products.

proof.text: Induct on the certificate. For a system certificate apply stage continuity to its complete coherent-system data and its supplied stage isomorphism. The cocone B is then colimiting; IsColimit.nonempty_isColimit_iff_isIso_desc identifies the canonical comparison as an isomorphism.

For an iso certificate use ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective. For composition and binary product use Function.Bijective.comp and Function.Bijective.prodMap on the induction hypotheses. These cases do not use geometric or Mayer--Vietoris results.
